# Assumption of Moses Chapter 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Conquest and Early History Foretold

---

**1** The Most High, the Eternal God who existed before all things and sits on the throne of his kingdom, speaks through me as a prophet to you. He will come to you and act as he promised to the fathers of Israel.

**2** He will enter the holy land and deal with it according to his decree. He will distribute it and give it to your tribes.

**3** You will be able to enter and settle in it, while I and all the tribal leaders will be gathered to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob our fathers.

**4** Then your kingdom will flourish and you will live in it for many years.

**5** After you, a ruler will arise among them who will govern the whole earth and judge it.

**6** Then in a short time they will be scattered among the nations and will remain under foreign domination for many years.

**7** But the Most High, who sees all things, will look upon their suffering and will deliver them through Moses, the great mediator.

**8** The tribes will be in the holy land, and you will complete your days.

**9** Remember, Joshua: it is not because of any virtue or strength on the part of this people that you have been appointed to lead them into their inheritance.

**10** It is because our fathers were faithful, and in his mercy God made his covenant with them and swore to multiply their descendants.

**11** And he has fulfilled and confirmed this faithfully.

**12** Enter the land he has promised to give them; give it to them as their inheritance; lead them according to everything he has prescribed.
